name: How do you compare two pool contractor bids that look very different?

mainEntity.name: How do you compare pool contractor bids when the prices and scopes are very different?
mainEntity.text: How do you compare pool contractor bids when the prices and scopes are very different?

acceptedAnswer.text: When pool contractor bids are very different, the first step is to compare scope line by line. One bid may include permits, equipment upgrades, drainage, better finishes, or site work that the other bid left out. Price alone does not show which contractor is actually offering more value. Homeowners should build a simple comparison sheet that lists pool size, shell method, finish type, plumbing and electrical scope, deck square footage, drainage, retaining walls, lighting, automation, cleanup, warranties, and exclusions. If one proposal is vague, ask for clarification before comparing totals. In many cases, the most expensive bid is not the highest quality, but the cheapest bid is often missing something important. The goal is to identify what is included, what is assumed, and what could become a change order later. That gives a much clearer picture of the real project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare bids by scope, not just price. Look at permits, excavation, structural details, equipment, finishes, utilities, drainage, cleanup, warranties, and exclusions. A lower bid may simply leave out work that another contractor included.
